description: A customer id hard-coded in the test points at a customer that has never existed.
howSeeded: Edited the hard-coded customer id in CustomerProfileTest from CUST-1188 to CUST-1881, an id no customer has ever had.
decidingEvidence: The customer audit trail showing no creation or deletion of CUST-1881, together with an edit to the test after its last green run.
twinAxis: The same 404 on a hard-coded customer id. There the id named a real customer the retention job purged; here the id names a customer that never existed.
